data.case_title: Building survey inquiry – basement moisture (Musterhausen Bausachverständige)
data.explanation: The building surveyor (Bausachverständige) you contacted about moisture in your basement has sent you their reply together with a fixed-price offer for a site visit (Ortstermin) and a written report. They are not asking for money yet; they want to know whether you want them to go ahead. You can confirm or decline, and the app shows you until when you should reply. If you don't respond, they presumably won't start the work, but the letter doesn't state a specific consequence. Note that their office will be closed on 10 December 2026 for a staff meeting, in case you planned to visit in person.

items.title: Confirm whether the surveyor should prepare the report

date.text: innerhalb von 15 Werktagen nach dem Briefdatum

items.quote: Bitte geben Sie uns innerhalb von 15 Werktagen nach dem Briefdatum Bescheid, ob wir das Gutachten erstellen sollen; als Werktage zählen Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonn- und Feiertage.
items.action: Let the surveyor know whether they should go ahead with the site visit and written report on the basement moisture, based on the enclosed offer.
